defective_pattern: Injecting <w:jc w:val='right'/> alongside <w:bidi w:val='1'/>, ignoring narrative justification in non-headings, leaving English acronyms untranslated in tables, appending bidiVisual at the end of tblPr, and misclassifying chapter by naive heading regex.
why_defective: Under OpenXML BiDi Golden Rule, w:jc right forces trailing-edge flip to Left-Alignment when w:bidi=1. tblPr requires bidiVisual to be the first child before tblW.
observed_symptoms: Headings aligned left instead of right.
Narrative paragraphs not justified (missing w:jc w:val='both').
Untranslated English acronyms in generated OpenXML tables.
Invalid OpenXML table schema due to w:bidiVisual positioned after w:tblW.
corrective_remedy: Strip w:jc elements from RTL headings/titles when w:bidi=1. Inject w:jc w:val='both' to non-heading Persian text. Sanitize English acronyms. Insert bidiVisual at the beginning of tblPr. Use strict metadata for chapter stage detection.
